About.title: I'm
About.intro: AI Native developer with a B.S. in Computer Science from UC Irvine, currently pursuing an M.S. in Analytics at USC. My focus is AI applications and full-stack development.

paragraphs: My studies span computer science and analytics. My projects focus on AI applications and web and desktop products, bringing together programming, data handling, and interface design through working features.

The portfolio includes MultiMix, a video-creation workspace; opc-workspace, a local desktop workspace; Omnigate, based on new-api; and As-a, a bilingual professional-services platform. Each project page explains its scope and current status.

AI coding tools are part of my daily development workflow. I use them to analyze code, implement features, and review changes, then check the results by reading code, running checks, and testing manually. This website was built with the same approach.

I'm interested in the process from understanding a requirement to putting an application into use, and am looking to develop further in an AI application, full-stack, or FDE role. The blog documents methods and learning notes for reference and discussion.

items.title: Discuss concrete problems
items.body: Include the use case, relevant code, and expected result when discussing a requirement or review comment, so others can understand and check the issue.

items.title: Explain implementation choices
items.body: Compare approaches against project constraints, record the reasons and limitations, and revise decisions based on verification and feedback.

items.title: Define contributions clearly
items.body: Credit open-source projects, distinguish upstream capabilities from custom work, and explain where AI tools contributed.

items.title: Consider the user experience
items.body: Check readability, interactions, and error feedback across screen sizes, including keyboard navigation, to make features easier to use.
